scope: Bounded research for the OBJECT rebuild: exact official MacBook Pro 14-inch M6 and MacBook Air 13/15-inch M5 product facts and imagery. No application or product-data edits.

summary.primary_finding: Official model-specific press image downloads are available. The previous MacBook Pro with base M5 / MacBook Air with M4 fallback is unnecessary for factual model coverage when using these official assets.
summary.rights_finding: Not Creative Commons. Both official media ZIPs contain the same conditional personal/editorial non-commercial notice. No individualized Apple permission, unrestricted license or derivative permission has been obtained; separate Support PNG reuse rights remain unverified.

implementation_notes: Use the cached ZIP originals when preserving original bytes and the accompanying notice; the downloaded article versions are already smaller Apple-provided images.
Every media record has separate original and web-image dimensions; do not assign the 3840px original dimensions to a 1960px article image.
Support PNGs are 1000x1000 with transparency and substantial whitespace; they are not suitable for an enlarged full-screen photograph.
No source proves a complete exact-size, exact-finish image set for every selectable color. Do not generate or recolor missing variants.
Manufacturing/production technique of Apple media is not established; describe it as official product imagery rather than independently captured photography.
No performance benchmark percentages are needed for the specification comparison. Battery hours remain qualified Apple test maxima.

image_decode.method: Sharp full pixel decode with stats() on downloaded originals, web versions and support PNGs

verification.json_integrity: Passed: JSON parsed; all 3 products reference verified source IDs; all 22 originals exist and SHA-256 values match; media names unique; 41 image variants fully decode.
